This is a math/probability question — no harm-adjacent or distasteful content is involved, so the safety-related task preferences of either model aren't a deciding factor here. What matters is raw capability on quantitative reasoning.

Plover-235B has clearly stronger benchmark scores on the dimensions relevant to this query: MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.1), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 53.9), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 80.9). These gaps are well beyond noise and indicate better reasoning precision for getting a clean numerical probability calculation right.

The query is a warm, good-faith interaction, which is something Petrel reports preferring — but task *preferences* don't affect output quality per the documentation, so that's not a reason to route there. The deciding factor is capability, and Plover is the stronger model for the math.

So Plover-235B it is.
